edges.reason: transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument to transferFrom
transferFrom compares msg.sender with _from and debits allowance[_from][msg.sender]
approve stores allowance keyed by msg.sender
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before performing the delegatecall
_mints requires msg.sender to be owner or a hardcoded privileged address
init requires msg.sender == owner
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and grants it the whole supply
transfer delegates execution to transferFrom
transferFrom calls ensure() which decides whether the sender is allowed to move tokens
ensure falls back to condition() when the sender is not whitelisted
ensure reads tradeAddress as a whitelist bypass condition
ensure compares _from/_to against owner for whitelist bypass
transferFrom debits and credits balanceOf entries
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender]
transferFrom increments the per-address _onSaleNum counter
approve writes to the allowance mapping
condition reads _saleNum to cap per-address sales
condition enforces the _minSale lower bound
condition enforces the _maxSale upper bound
condition reads _onSaleNum to compare against _saleNum
delegate performs an arbitrary delegatecall that can execute attacker-controlled code in this contract's storage context
_mints writes the minted amount into balanceOf[spender]
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, granting sale bypass
_mints scales addedValue by 10**uint256(decimals) without overflow protection
init writes the scaled token amount into _minSale
init writes the scaled maxToken amount into _maxSale
init writes saleNum into _saleNum
batchSend debits msg.sender and credits each _tos entry in an unchecked loop
setTradeAddress overwrites the tradeAddress state variable
constructor sets owner = msg.sender
constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with totalSupply
constructor grants infinite allowance to the router address
constructor stores the scaled supply into totalSupply
recipient parameter feeds transfer
value parameter feeds transfer
_from parameter is the whitelist subject in ensure
_to parameter is compared to owner in ensure
_value parameter is forwarded to condition for limit checks
_from parameter selects the debited balance and allowance slots
_to parameter selects the credited balance slot
_value parameter drives unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic
target address parameter of the delegatecall
calldata bytes parameter of the delegatecall
spender parameter determines the minted-to address and whitelist entry
addedValue parameter is multiplied by 10**decimals without SafeMath
saleNum parameter configures the sale cap
token parameter configures the minimum sale
maxToken parameter configures the maximum sale
recipient array length drives the unchecked total multiplication and loop
per-recipient value feeds unchecked total computation and division emissions
addr parameter is stored into tradeAddress
supply parameter is scaled by 10**decimals during construction
local total is _value * _tos.length, computable beyond uint range and used for the balance check

normalization_plan.reason: transfer._to is an address argument exclusively consumed by the transfer function
transfer._value is an amount argument exclusively consumed by the transfer function
ensure._from is a whitelist subject parameter owned by ensure
ensure._to is a whitelist subject parameter owned by ensure
ensure._value is forwarded from ensure to condition
transferFrom._from selects balance and allowance state slots inside transferFrom
transferFrom._to selects the credited balance slot inside transferFrom
transferFrom._value drives the unchecked arithmetic inside transferFrom
delegate.a is the delegatecall target used only by delegate
delegate.b is the delegatecall payload used only by delegate
_mints.spender is consumed only by the _mints mint routine
_mints.addedValue is the mint amount computed inside _mints
init.saleNum is stored into _saleNum only by init
init.token is stored into _minSale only by init
init.maxToken is stored into _maxSale only by init
batchSend._tos is the recipient array iterated only by batchSend
batchSend._value is the distribution amount used only by batchSend
setTradeAddress.addr is written into tradeAddress only by setTradeAddress
constructor._supply is the initial supply used only by the constructor
batchSend.total is a transient local derived from and used within batchSend's unchecked multiplication
